_meta.note: Semantic question contract for conditional service eligibility. Not a UI specification. One question may drive one or more eligibility predicates. Questions are referenced by ID from service entries.

Q-ELEC-MCB-DEFECT.question_fr: Le disjoncteur est-il physiquement cassé (bouton bloqué, boîtier fissuré, levier ne restant pas en position) — ou saute-t-il à répétition sans raison claire ?
Q-ELEC-MCB-DEFECT.question_ar_darija: واش الديسجونكتور مكسور جسمياً (مفتاحه ما كيمشيش) — ولا كيوقف وحده باستمرار بلا سبب واضح؟

allowed_answers.label_fr: Physiquement cassé (bouton bloqué ou boîtier fissuré)
Saute à répétition ou sans raison claire

blocking_conditions: trips_repeatedly → DIAGNOSTIC_FIRST: book electricite.diagnostic (200 MAD) before replacement
Q-ELEC-MCB-DEFECT.why_needed: An electrician must NEVER replace a breaker merely because it trips. Repeated tripping = downstream fault requiring diagnostic first. Replacing without diagnosis is a safety hazard.

Q-ELEC-DISTRIBUTOR.question_fr: S'agit-il du disjoncteur de branchement — l'appareil séparé de votre tableau, typiquement avec un sceau du distributeur ?
Q-ELEC-DISTRIBUTOR.question_ar_darija: واش هو ديسجونكتور الكيد ديال الكمبيني — اللي مع ختم الشركة ومنفصل على التابلو ديالك؟

allowed_answers.label_fr: Non — c'est dans mon tableau électrique privé

blocking_conditions: True → absolute exclusion: charge 200 MAD diagnostic, direct client to ONEE or territory distributor
Q-ELEC-DISTRIBUTOR.why_needed: Distributor-controlled equipment is legally and technically outside FIXEO electrician scope. Tampering is illegal. Identification must happen before dispatch.

Q-ELEC-BURNING-SMELL.question_fr: Y a-t-il une odeur de brûlé ou des traces noires dans votre tableau électrique ?
Q-ELEC-BURNING-SMELL.question_ar_darija: واش كاين ريحة محروق أو آثار سواد في التابلو ديالك؟

allowed_answers.label_fr: Oui — odeur de brûlé ou traces noires

blocking_conditions: True → SAFETY_OVERRIDE: HORS PÉRIMÈTRE, full tableau assessment required → QUOTE
Q-ELEC-BURNING-SMELL.why_needed: Burning smell or scorch marks indicate overheating — a fire hazard. POL-ELECTRICAL-SAFETY-V1 mandates STOP before any panel work.

Q-SERR-DOOR-SLAMMED-ONLY.question_fr: La porte s'est-elle claquée (fermée par le vent ou involontairement) sans avoir été verrouillée à clé ?
Q-SERR-DOOR-SLAMMED-ONLY.question_ar_darija: واش الباب انسكر وحده (من الريح أو بلا قصد) بلا ما يتدير بالمفتاح؟

allowed_answers.label_fr: Oui — claquée seulement, pas de clé

Q-SERR-DOOR-SLAMMED-ONLY.why_needed: Distinguishes serrurerie.porte_claquee_ouverture (220 MAD) from serrurerie.porte_verrouillee_ouverture (380 MAD). Different technique and price.

Q-SERR-SECURITY-DOOR.question_fr: Est-ce une porte blindée ou renforcée ?
Q-SERR-SECURITY-DOOR.why_needed: Security doors require different technique. Price: 350 MAD vs 220 MAD. Determines which service applies.

Q-SERR-AUTHORIZATION.question_fr: Êtes-vous le propriétaire ou l'occupant légitime de ce logement ?
Q-SERR-AUTHORIZATION.question_ar_darija: واش نتا صاحب الدار أو ساكن فيها بشكل قانوني؟

allowed_answers.label_fr: Je suis le propriétaire / l'occupant — je serai présent

blocking_conditions: unknown → STOP — artisan verifies authorization before proceeding. POL-SERRURERIE-AUTHORIZATION-V1.
Q-SERR-AUTHORIZATION.why_needed: Serrurerie services involve access to a locked property. Artisan must verify occupancy authorization. This is a safety and legal requirement, not optional.

Q-CLIM-LEAK-LOCATION.question_fr: Où se situe la fuite de réfrigérant ? (tuyau cuivre extérieur accessible / intérieur de l'unité / inconnu ?)
Q-CLIM-LEAK-LOCATION.question_ar_darija: فين كاين تسرب الغاز؟ (أنبوب النحاس الخارجي / داخل الجهاز / ما عارفش؟)

allowed_answers.label_fr: Tuyau cuivre extérieur — visible et accessible
Dans un mur ou une dalle (encastré)
Je ne sais pas où est la fuite

blocking_conditions: anything except EXTERNAL_ACCESSIBLE_COPPER → HORS PÉRIMÈTRE or DIAGNOSTIC_FIRST
Q-CLIM-LEAK-LOCATION.why_needed: CLIM-013 (600 MAD) is for accessible external copper pipe only. Other leak locations require quote. This prevents artisan dispatch for out-of-scope situations.

Q-CLIM-REFRIGERANT-TYPE.question_fr: Quel réfrigérant utilise votre climatiseur ? (R32, R410A, R22 — visible sur l'unité extérieure)
Q-CLIM-REFRIGERANT-TYPE.question_ar_darija: أش نوع الغاز ديال كليماتيك ديالك؟ (مكتوب على الوحدة الخارجية: R32، R410A، R22)
blocking_conditions: R32 without certified artisan → ROUTE to R32/A2L specialist
route_conditions: R32 → POL-REFRIGERATION-INTEGRITY-V1, check artisan certification before dispatch
Q-CLIM-REFRIGERANT-TYPE.why_needed: R32 is A2L mildly flammable. Work on R32 requires specific certified equipment and artisan training. Safety-critical dispatch check.

Q-CLIM-INSTALL-COPPER-LENGTH.question_fr: Quelle est la distance approximative entre l'unité intérieure et l'unité extérieure ?
Q-CLIM-INSTALL-COPPER-LENGTH.question_ar_darija: قياس شحال التقريبية بين الوحدة الداخلية والخارجية؟
blocking_conditions: above_5m → requires CLIM-025 per-extra-metre add-on (not yet calibrated) or QUOTE
Q-CLIM-INSTALL-COPPER-LENGTH.why_needed: CLIM-020 includes up to 3m copper. CLIM-021 includes up to 5m. Beyond 5m triggers CLIM-025 (deferred, not yet approved) or QUOTE.

Q-MENU-DOOR-TYPE.question_fr: De quel type de porte s'agit-il ?
route_conditions: blindee → serrurerie services (appropriate service depends on situation)
Q-MENU-DOOR-TYPE.why_needed: Menuiserie services apply to interior wooden/MDF doors. Security doors are serrurerie scope. Aluminium/PVC doors may have different eligibility — artisan confirms on site.

Q-MENU-SECURITY-DOOR.question_fr: Est-ce une porte blindée ou renforcée ?
blocking_conditions: True → ROUTE to serrurerie. Menuiserie services ineligible.
Q-MENU-SECURITY-DOOR.why_needed: All menuiserie door services explicitly exclude security doors. Hard routing gate.

Q-MENU-FRAME-CONDITION.question_fr: Le cadre de la porte est-il en bon état ? (Pas de bois pourri, pas de déformation structurelle du bâti ?)
Q-MENU-FRAME-CONDITION.question_ar_darija: واش إطار الباب مزيان؟ (ماشي فيه عفن ولا تشويه في الهيكل؟)

allowed_answers.label_fr: Légèrement endommagé — artisan juge sur place

blocking_conditions: ROTTED → HORS PÉRIMÈTRE — frame must be replaced/repaired first
STRUCTURALLY_DEFORMED → HORS PÉRIMÈTRE → maçonnerie or QUOTE
Q-MENU-FRAME-CONDITION.why_needed: Rotten or structurally deformed door frames are outside menuiserie standardized scope. Artisan cannot safely complete the service.

Q-MENU-MASONRY-REQUIRED.question_fr: L'installation nécessite-t-elle des travaux de maçonnerie (agrandissement de l'ouverture, réparation du mur) ?
Q-MENU-MASONRY-REQUIRED.question_ar_darija: واش التركيب محتاج أشغال بناء (توسيع الفتحة أو إصلاح الحيط)؟

allowed_answers.label_fr: Oui — modification de la maçonnerie requise

blocking_conditions: True → HORS PÉRIMÈTRE. Masonry pre-work required before MENU_006.
Q-MENU-MASONRY-REQUIRED.why_needed: MENU_006 (500 MAD door installation) requires existing compatible frame. Masonry modification → HORS PÉRIMÈTRE.

Q-MENU-DOOR-WIDTH.question_fr: Quelle est la largeur de la porte (en cm) ? Les dimensions standard sont 73 cm, 83 cm ou 93 cm.
Q-MENU-DOOR-WIDTH.question_ar_darija: شحال عرض الباب (بالسانتيمتر)؟ الأبعاد المعيارية هي 73 أو 83 أو 93 سم.
blocking_conditions: other → eligibility flag — artisan assesses on site. If >2cm trim required → QUOTE
Q-MENU-DOOR-WIDTH.why_needed: MENU_006 scope: standard Moroccan residential interior door widths (73, 83, 93 cm). Non-standard may require custom trimming → out of scope.

Q-PEIN-ACTIVE-MOISTURE.question_fr: Y a-t-il des traces d'humidité active, d'infiltration ou de moisissure ?
Q-PEIN-ACTIVE-MOISTURE.question_ar_darija: واش كاين رطوبة نشيطة، تسرب أو تعفن فالحيطان؟
blocking_conditions: True → HORS PÉRIMÈTRE ABSOLU — resolve moisture source first (plomberie or toiture). No painting until source resolved.
route_conditions: True → route to plomberie (internal leak) or toiture specialist (roof) depending on source
Q-PEIN-ACTIVE-MOISTURE.why_needed: Painting over active moisture is harmful and pointless. POL-PAINTED-SURFACE-V1 is absolute — active moisture = peinture out of scope.

Q-PEIN-SURFACE-CONDITION.question_fr: Dans quel état sont les murs ?

allowed_answers.label_fr: Prêts à peindre — propres, secs, stables
Légèrement abîmés — quelques trous, fissures fines

Q-PEIN-SURFACE-CONDITION.why_needed: Routes client to correct peinture service. READY_TO_PAINT → PEIN-002/003. MINOR_PREPARATION → PEIN-005 or PEIN-008 add-on. Major/structural → out of scope.

Q-PEIN-CLIENT-SUPPLIES-PAINT.question_fr: Fournissez-vous la peinture vous-même, ou souhaitez-vous que l'artisan fournisse la peinture standard ?
Q-PEIN-CLIENT-SUPPLIES-PAINT.question_ar_darija: واش غتجيب الصبغة بنفسك، أم تبغي العامل يجيب الصبغة المعيارية؟
Q-PEIN-CLIENT-SUPPLIES-PAINT.why_needed: Hard routing gate between PEIN-002 (35 MAD/m², labour only) and PEIN-003/005 (65–75 MAD/m², all-in). Different price, different scope.

Q-NET-PROPERTY-TYPE.question_fr: Quel type de bien souhaitez-vous faire nettoyer en profondeur ?
Q-NET-PROPERTY-TYPE.question_ar_darija: أش نوع الملك اللي بغيتي تنظفو بشكل عميق؟
blocking_conditions: villa → QUOTE_REQUIRED: 600 MAD does not cover villas
f4_f5_large → no approved tier — advise client, may offer hourly or QUOTE
Q-NET-PROPERTY-TYPE.why_needed: NET-004 (grand nettoyage 600 MAD) is calibrated for F2/F3 apartments (60–100 m²). Villa scope → QUOTE_REQUIRED. Other sizes not yet approved.

Q-BRIC-TV-SIZE.question_fr: Quelle est la taille de votre télévision (en pouces) ?
blocking_conditions: >65 inches → eligibility flag — artisan confirms on site. Very large screen may require QUOTE
Q-BRIC-TV-SIZE.why_needed: BRIC-030 standard scope: ≤65 inches / ≤40 kg. Above threshold → scope change or heavy mounting quote.
